card.statement: The category $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$, together with the “weight poset” $(X_{*}(T)^{+},\leq)$, the “standard objects” $\{\mathcal{J}_{!}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}):\lambda\in X_{*}(T)^{+}\}$ and the “costandard objects” $\{\mathcal{J}_{*}(\lambda,\mathbf{k}):\lambda\in X_{*}(T)^{+}\}$, is a highest weight category.
card.label: Proposition 12.4

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
